description: Get the score history for one page on a benchmarq-tracked domain. Returns scored data points (overall score, grade, and the GEO/AIO/AEO/CORE pillar scores) for the given URL, newest first, up to `limit` of them (default 20, max 100 -- pass a smaller limit like 3-5 if you only need the latest score, recent trend, or historical jobId to save context tokens). Each point may also include app (ARO) and ecom (ACO) scores -- these are optional, opt-in extra checks for app-like or e-commerce pages, not part of every scan. They are null when that check type was not run or does not apply to the page, not when scoring failed, and they are never included in the overall score or in GEO/AIO/AEO/CORE. Use this to see how a specific page's scores have changed over time.
name: get_page_scores
title: Get page scores
